description: NaPO₃ crystallizes in the monoclinic P2₁/c space group. There are two inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded to six O atoms to form distorted NaO₆ pentagonal pyramids that share corners with two equivalent NaO₆ pentagonal pyramids, corners with five PO₄ tetrahedra, edges with three NaO₆ pentagonal pyramids, and  an edgeedge with one PO₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.35-2.57 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded to six O atoms to form distorted NaO₆ pentagonal pyramids that share corners with four NaO₆ pentagonal pyramids, corners with five PO₄ tetrahedra, edges with two equivalent NaO₆ pentagonal pyramids, and  an edgeedge with one PO₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.25-2.53 Å. There are two inequivalent P sites. In the first P site, P is bonded to four O atoms to form PO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with five NaO₆ pentagonal pyramids, corners with two equivalent PO₄ tetrahedra, and  an edgeedge with one NaO₆ pentagonal pyramid. There are a spread of P-O bond distances ranging from 1.48-1.61 Å. In the second P site, P is bonded to four O atoms to form PO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with five NaO₆ pentagonal pyramids, corners with two equivalent PO₄ tetrahedra, and  an edgeedge with one NaO₆ pentagonal pyramid. There are a spread of P-O bond distances ranging from 1.48-1.61 Å. There are six inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a distorted trigonal planar geometry to two Na and one P atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na and two P atoms. In the third O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to two Na and one P atom. In the fourth O site, O is bonded to three Na and one P atom to form distorted edge-sharing ONa₃P tetrahedra. In the fifth O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to three Na and one P atom. In the sixth O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na and two P atoms.
